title: Project Sundial — Confidential Information Memorandum: Slumber Smart, Inc.
summary: Goldman Sachs-prepared CIM for Slumber Smart, Inc. ("Project Sundial"), a Boulder, CO-based premium sleep-tech hardware and software platform. The Company designs and sells an integrated ecosystem of smart mattress pads (SlumberPod™), biometric monitoring hardware, and AI-powered sleep coaching software (SlumberOS™). LTM revenue of $145M growing at 28% YoY, with $18M Adj. EBITDA (12.4% margin) and $29M subscription ARR at 115% NRR. Goldman Sachs is running a limited sell-side auction with a guided enterprise value of ~$200M (11.1x LTM EBITDA). Management projects revenue growing to $340M by FY2026 with EBITDA margins expanding to 21.8%. Key investment themes include a proprietary hardware-software flywheel, premium DTC economics (LTV/CAC of 10.6x), and a structurally growing sleep-wellness TAM.

key_quotes.quote: Slumber Smart holds 35% share in the smart mattress sub-segment — 2.5x next closest competitor
$29M ARR growing ~60% YoY; subscription attached to 73% of hardware sold in trailing 12 months. 115% Net Revenue Retention.
CAC of ~$180 and an LTV of ~$1,900, yielding a <6-month payback period.

Each night of use feeds the SlumberAI model — accuracy improves with scale, creating embedded switching cost. Software platform (SlumberOS) handles 95M+ nightly data points; 3.2M+ nights of training data accumulated.

growth_drivers: Subscription ARR growing ~60% YoY; $29M ARR with 73% hardware attach rate
115% Net Revenue Retention from Basic-to-Premium subscription upsell
DTC model driving 45%+ gross margins and superior unit economics (LTV/CAC of 10.6x)
Retail expansion to Nordstrom, Crate & Barrel, and Best Buy
International expansion (UK, AU launched; Europe DE/FR/NL targeted for 2023)
Adjacent SKU pipeline: SlumberPillow, SlumberCrib, SlumberPro B2B
Gross margin expansion from 45.5% to 51.8% driven by growing software mix
risks: Founder/CEO dependency — Maya Chen holds 6 of 10 granted patents and built the company from inception
Manufacturing concentration in Taiwan (single OEM source)
Hardware gross margins (~44%) dilute blended profitability; competitive pressure from Eight Sleep
Consumer discretionary spending sensitivity; high ASP ($999–$1,799) limits addressable market
Relatively modest EBITDA base ($18M LTM) at a premium entry multiple (~11x)

title: Project Sundial — Executive Teaser
summary: Goldman Sachs-run limited auction teaser for Project Sundial / Slumber Smart, Inc., a Boulder, CO-based premium sleep-tech hardware and software company founded in 2014. LTM revenue of $145M (+28% YoY), LTM Adj. EBITDA of $18M (12.4% margin), and subscription ARR of $29M (~185K subscribers, 115% NRR). Asking EV of ~$200M (11.1x LTM EBITDA). Process timeline runs April–June 2022. Investment highlights emphasize category leadership in sleep-tech, a hardware+software flywheel (SlumberOS), high-growth SaaS subscription layer, strong DTC unit economics, and international expansion whitespace. Founder-led by CEO Maya Chen (ex-Fitbit).

key_quotes.quote: Building the leading platform for precision sleep optimization
Subscription revenue ($29M ARR) is growing ~60% YoY with 115% NRR. The software layer is on a path to represent 30%+ of revenue by 2025, supporting a richer valuation profile.
CAC of $180 against LTV of $1,900+ (hardware + 3yr sub). Payback period <6 months on DTC channel.
The SlumberOS platform creates a proprietary data loop: each night of sleep data improves algorithm accuracy, deepening engagement and creating switching costs that generic hardware cannot replicate.

growth_drivers: High-growth SaaS subscription layer ($29M ARR, ~60% YoY, 115% NRR)
Hardware+software flywheel creating switching costs via SlumberOS platform
Expanding DTC and retail distribution (Nordstrom, Crate & Barrel) with strong unit economics (CAC $180, LTV $1,900+)
International geographic expansion (UK, AU launched 2021; DE, FR targeted 2023)
Adjacent product SKUs in late-stage development (smart pillow, crib monitor)
risks: Low household penetration of sleep-tech hardware (<2% US) may slow adoption
Founder/management dependency — CEO is founder Maya Chen
Hardware ASP of $1,450 creates consumer affordability sensitivity
